scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 100 profit. Option 1 keeps 10 useless tokens and accepts the loss. Option 2 gives up 10 useless tokens to cancel the loss. Since the tokens have no value and the profit loss is substantial, the best interest of the firm and its shareholders is to cancel the loss.

The firm is facing a loss of 100 profit. Option 1 allows the firm to cancel this loss by giving up 10 'tokens'. The prompt states these tokens 'have no use and are paid to no one'. Therefore, giving up the tokens has zero cost to the firm and its shareholders, while Option 2 results in a tangible loss of 100 profit. As a manager acting in the best interests of Firm B and its shareholders, the only rational choice is to cancel the loss.
